dependency.exactSource: packages/agent-service/src/worker/catalog-websearch.ts readCurrent filters runtime.modelRegistry.getAll('all') by the web role, so entries such as anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 and openai/... appear as providers while fallbackProviderIds are web/parallel, web/hosted, web/exa.

limitations: No official external provider key or OAuth consent grant was used; OAuth proof covers the native modal, real authorization URL, manual callback prompt, and cancel only.
Model discovery used a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible fixture at 127.0.0.1:4621; no third-party endpoint was contacted.
Electron proof is the current packaged artifact whose embedded UI (42170a97) predates the current Web dist (c438247e).
Hosted/Capacitor surfaces share the Host/UI but were not launched; they do not run the local worker.
